purpose: one native G0-identical training trajectory, two EMA records (counter 0 vs 36480), fixed FT012 endpoint evaluation of both; record only

parent.source: certified common-protocol R18 seed0 full checkpoint, EMA.module only

precision: original BF16 forward, FP32 losses; no scaler
view_rule: original whole-image views only (position-mapped, no draws); identical to the completed G0 stream
data: original train_core 4869; 4864 views/pass, original drop_last5 rule; seed0 sampler epochs109..120
augmentation: original RawAugmentation; local pass1..12 maps epoch109..120; strong first9, off last3; flip always retained; no fixed crops
optimizer: new AdamW; original norm/bn name groups, betas0.9/0.999, WD1e-4 except norm/bn0; clip0.1

ema_r.init: parent EMA weights (strict-loaded), module bitwise identical to EMA-C before update 1

ema_c.init: same parent EMA weights; constructed from the same model state as EMA-R
ema_c.rule: identical R0EMA update math; stepped once per training update on the same post-optimizer-step model state, EMA-R first then EMA-C; neither EMA feeds back into training; the second EMA consumes no training RNG draw

dual_ema_note: the only difference between the two records is the update counter used by decay d=decay*(1-exp(-updates/warmups)); no decay/warmup/selection change is permitted in response to results
checkpoint_passes_note: declared BEFORE writing to stay inside the 8 GiB server-new budget: complete states at pass 0, 6 and 12 (the endpoint is always saved); pass-level wire events are still emitted for every pass; nothing written is deleted afterwards
endpoint: FT012; both EMA modules evaluated once each (R and C); no intermediate point selection, no decay change, no added module
inference: original A only (whole-image), Q300, FP32, 548 development, top600/top300, original two evaluators and raw-ignore; truncate then filter, no refill
reference_metrics: original G0 (production-002 evaluation G0-A-top600/300) and the parent metrics, read-only
verdict: quality = RECORD_ONLY: descriptive only. It answers how much the EMA counter start changes the fixed-endpoint evaluation on this identical trajectory. It cannot answer the optimizer-reset causal contribution, cannot attribute any difference to the platform, and cannot prove any module's efficacy
future_stop: engineering exception or budget overrun during the formal run or after launch = STOP, no automatic retry, no material deletion to free space, no config change and rerun; development issues inside this round's scope are fixed continuously before the release freeze
retention: all new material is retained on the server (no post-hoc pruning)
